digest.component_or_area: plan review attestation and sign-review recovery
propositions: When attestation persists a PASS verdict but the signature write fails AND the sidecar did not persist, the system advertises an unrecoverable sign-review recovery path instead of requiring a fresh review-plan run
The existing classify_plan_review_attestation function discriminates three failure cases but its catch-all branch never inspects the sidecar_emitted field despite it being present on the result dict
When both sidecar and signature are lost, sign-review correctly refuses to re-sign but the recorded verdict silently remains the previous round's BLOCK, creating a stale contradicting state
A new ATTESTATION_SIDECAR_LOST cause must be added to classify_plan_review_attestation, branching before the catch-all, when sign fails and sidecar_emitted is explicitly False
